meta.use_when: You need a marketing band of headline statistics separated by dividers.

docs: A marketing band of headline statistics separated by vertical dividers on a card background. Do: Color headline numbers from the accent-driven token (--accent-pigment), so they follow the page's data-accent like every other emphasis element. Don't: Hardcode a fixed pigment (e.g. --terracotta) for the numbers — that breaks when a consumer sets a different accent. Use stat-cards when each number needs its own card with a period-over-period delta — this pattern is a single flat band with no per-item chrome or comparison. Use feature-section when you're describing capabilities, not reporting numbers.
